title: feed envelope
description: One envelope for every published feed (eco-system ticket 04/21; ADR-0019). The signature is the gitsign tag on the publisher repo and nothing else: there is no in-band signature field, because a signature cannot cover itself. Only `payload` differs between a regulator's penalty schema and a prediction-market move. A feed file lives at <feed-name>/v<MAJOR>/feed.json in its publisher repo, with rule.yaml and bump.yaml beside it and the payload schema at <feed-name>/payload.schema.json.

kind.description: The closed parent kind. feed: anything that prices and carries no rules. controls: a catalogue plus named baselines. implementations: policy bodies plus control claims.

name.description: The free name under the kind, e.g. 'threat-register', 'penalty-schema'. A new publisher declares a new name with no platform change.

version.description: Semver, no leading v. Equal to the tag that signs it: '<name>/vX.Y.Z' on a multi-feed repo, 'vX.Y.Z' on a single-feed repo.

published_by.description: The publishing party's name, as on its party.yaml.

payload_schema.description: Repo-relative path or URL of the JSON Schema the payload validates against. A change here is always a major bump.

payload.description: The feed body. Validated against payload_schema, never here.
